usedFor: Bannerbear generates the images, and “New Image” there can start “Create Folder” in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “New Image” in Bannerbear, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It turns a file into a shareable link with Viewer, Commenter or Editor access once an image exists.

watchOut: “New Image” in Bannerbear is polling, so a short delay before Google Drive acts is normal.
